editorial_review_row.content: BlackBull Markets scores 7.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. An FMA New Zealand-regulated ECN broker with raw spreads from 0.0 pips on Prime ($6 RT), six trading platforms including free TradingView Premium, and 26,000+ instruments. Execution speed ranked #1 globally. The catch — only mid-tier regulation with no investor compensation scheme, a $5 flat withdrawal fee on every method, and clone warnings from both FCA and FMA about imposter websites. Legitimate and growing fast toward a potential IPO, but you carry the counterparty risk that Tier-1 regulated traders do not.
